versions.name: Imminent Showdown
versions.text: Starts with 3 counters. After an ally GIGA Queen dies, spend a counter to add a copy of it to your deck with +2/+2/+2 base stats. After an ally GIGA Queen dies at 0 counters, add a Detachable Hands to your hand and disable this.
versions.note: Miraheze: Now gives each copy of GIGA Queen +1/+2/+2 base stats instead of +2/+2/+2 base stats.
